reasoning: On the season so far the Pacers are the stronger team; with home court the Pacers start about 4 points better, in a game of about 228 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 0 points towards the Wizards.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Wizards (look-ahead).
Bottom line: the Pacers win 59 times in 100, by about 3; most games like this end between 202 and 250 total points.

analyst.text: Both teams arrive frustrated. Washington have lost four straight, and Anthony Davis scored 44 in his return and then said flatly that the team is "not playing any defense". Indiana are 0-4 at home and have lost seven of eight with Tyrese Haliburton out indefinitely, and Rick Carlisle came out of Monday's last-second loss in Dallas ripping the officials. Neither side has a clear mental edge. Davis's visible frustration could cut either way; a slight lean goes to Indiana's desperation to win a first home game.
